semantic.justification: Presents browser document selection, computer ODT/TXT import, browser copy creation, and ODT/TXT export. This browser policy is an intentional upstream divergence and must not be rewritten by parity work. Task2BTWEE extracts the actual Writer file-dialog presentation,dialog header,primary-name collision choices and observable file-dialog request owner into framework/browser. Suite adapters supply supported formats,canonical IO callbacks and primary stores;shared presentation owns only tab,busy,error,drop and collision drafts. Writer preserves ODT/TXT behavior,its modal marker and existing primary-save policy. Shared office-dialog CSS aliases retain original Writer styling and responsive layout. Calc uses this same presentation for ODS files;no duplicate suite-specific file UI implementation or recovery UI is introduced. S3HW1E HTML85: LibreOffice dictionary range dispatch retains native Unicode category and directional skip behavior, locale overrides and Hungarian fallback. Original source boundary results agreed on 241428 inputs. Writer borrows its actual LanguageTag locale. Browser prepares the five local ICU assets through the existing Markdown open command and supplies the native word factory before shell import.
